verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe the feature directly. You put coding conventions, build/test commands and architecture notes in an AGENTS.md at the repo root, and Grok follows them without being told each session. It also reads AGENTS.md variants, CLAUDE.md, and .claude/rules/ and .cursor/rules/ for compatibility, and `grok inspect` shows which instruction files it discovered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the agent actually adheres to the instructions file.
